security_audit.summary: Two command examples automatically execute an unpinned npm package, creating a supply-chain risk in an environment configured with an API key. The remaining 38 findings concern Markdown formatting, ordinary Chinese text, creator identifiers, service links, or documented authentication. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or destructive intent in the supplied files; external package behavior was not reviewed.

remediation.issue: Both direct CLI examples execute socialdatax-skills@latest with automatic installation approval.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and verify its provenance before execution. Explain installation changes and obtain authorization before running downloaded code.

content.user_title: Compare Xiaohongshu Creators for Brand Collaborations
content.value_statement: Creator selection requires comparing prices, audience fit, and content evidence within a budget. This skill guides SocialDataX queries and produces candidate comparisons with costs, limitations, and follow-up questions.
actual_capabilities: Compare user-supplied creators using returned prices, audience profiles, and content performance.
Resolve creator homepage links to platform user IDs before commercial queries.
Select relevant commercial endpoints and estimate credit costs before querying.
Compare daily or sponsored content using consistent supported note scopes and returned reporting windows.
Produce candidate tables separating API facts, recommendations, missing data, and budget judgments.
Preserve partial results and stop commercial queries when the service reports unavailable data.
limitations: Requires SocialDataX credentials, service access, and sufficient credits; direct CLI execution also requires Node.js and npm.
Evaluates supplied candidates only and does not contact creators, negotiate prices, place orders, or sign contracts.
Cannot request arbitrary performance dates or guarantee complete audience distributions and commercial data.
Does not predict sales or actual ROI; zero quotes and missing values require clarification.

use_cases.title: Screen Candidates Against a Brand Budget
use_cases.description: Compare supplied creator quotes against campaign constraints and identify candidates needing pricing confirmation.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Evidence-Based Client Shortlist
use_cases.description: Compare audience fit and sponsored-content performance while separating returned facts from agency recommendations.

use_cases.title: Review Data Gaps Before Procurement
use_cases.description: Check source dates, missing commercial data, estimated query costs, and unresolved terms before approving further collaboration discussions.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Creator Evaluation
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate [creator IDs or homepages] for [product], targeting [audience], within [budget]. Explain proposed query costs before proceeding.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: evaluate a supplied candidate list.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Budget-Only Screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Screen [creator IDs] against [budget] for [content format]. Query pricing first, estimate credits, and flag zero or missing quotes for confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: minimize queries during initial budget screening.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Audience and Sponsored Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [creator IDs] for [target audience]. Use consistent sponsored-content scopes and returned date windows. Separate audience evidence, performance facts, and recommendations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare audience fit and commercial content evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Cost-Controlled Multi-Candidate Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan pricing, audience, and performance queries for [three creator IDs]. Estimate credits before execution. Preserve partial results and stop unavailable commercial queries. Avoid ROI claims.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: manage query scope, costs, and incomplete evidence.

output_examples.input: Plan pricing, audience, and performance queries for three supplied creators.
output: Planned scope: three commercial endpoints for each of three creators.
Estimated cost: nine successful queries at 20 credits each, totaling 180 credits.
Any required homepage resolution has a separate command cost.
Pending: confirm the query scope and estimated credits before execution.

output_examples.input: Illustrative returned data: Creator A has a zero quote; Creator B reports commercial data unavailable.
output: Creator A: pricing requires confirmation. A zero quote does not establish free collaboration.
Creator B: commercial evaluation is incomplete. Preserve available results and stop commercial retries.
Recommendation: obtain missing terms before choosing a creator. No actual ROI estimate is supported.

best_practices: Confirm candidate IDs, endpoint scope, and estimated credits before commercial queries; use a reviewed, pinned CLI package version.
Compare consistent note scopes and returned reporting windows, and retain available evidence links.
Keep API keys out of reports and separate returned facts from judgments and unresolved questions.
anti_patterns: Query every endpoint or expand the candidate list without confirming scope and costs.
Treat zero quotes as free, fill missing dates with zero, add medians, or promise sales and actual ROI.
Retry unavailable commercial data with altered inputs or present ordinary profile data as commercial evidence.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the brand or product, target audience, budget, and candidate creator IDs or homepage links.

faq.question: What setup does the skill require?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and sufficient service credits. Direct CLI use requires Node.js, npm, and shell access; equivalent MCP tools are also listed.

faq.question: How are commercial queries charged?
faq.answer: The skill states that each successful commercial endpoint query costs 20 credits; failures are not charged. Homepage resolution has a separate command cost.

faq.question: Can I choose any performance date range?
faq.answer: No. Performance and trend queries use service-defined windows. Comparisons must use returned dates and supported note scopes.

faq.question: Does the skill contact creators or predict sales?
faq.answer: No. It performs read-only evaluation and prepares recommendations. It does not send messages, negotiate, sign contracts, or predict actual sales and ROI.

faq.question: What happens when commercial data is unavailable?
faq.answer: The skill preserves available results and marks the missing commercial data. It stops those queries instead of changing inputs to bypass the limitation.
